welcome.intended: Welcome to the Story Repair Shop! Choose a storybook.
welcome.transcript: Welcome to the Story Repair Shop! Choose a storybook.

mode-repair.intended: Mend the Story. Listen, then find what makes sense.
mode-repair.transcript: Mend the Story. Listen, then find what makes sense.

mode-silly.intended: Wild Endings. Listen, then choose the wonderfully impossible ending.
mode-silly.transcript: Wild Endings. Listen, then choose the wonderfully impossible ending.

open-repair.intended: Tap the torn paper to open the Repair Shop.
open-repair.transcript: Tap the torn paper to open the Repair Shop.

drag-piece.intended: Choose a painted piece. Drag it to the torn spot, or tap the piece and then tap the spot.
drag-piece.transcript: Choose a painted piece. Drag it to the torn spot, or tap the piece and then tap the spot.

retry-repair.intended: That makes a different story. Listen once more and find what helps.
retry-repair.transcript: That makes a different story. Listen once more and find what helps.

retry-silly.intended: That could really happen! Can you find the wonderfully wild ending?
retry-silly.transcript: That could really happen! Can you find the wonderfully wild ending?

idle-repeat.intended: Let’s hear the story once more.
idle-repeat.transcript: Let’s hear the story once more.

idle-model.intended: The golden glow shows where the repair belongs.
idle-model.transcript: The golden glow shows where the repair belongs.

next-page.intended: Turn the page for the next story.
next-page.transcript: Turn the page for the next story.

mode-complete.intended: Three stories repaired! Your storybook is shining.
mode-complete.transcript: Three stories repaired! Your storybook is shining.

all-complete.intended: You repaired every kind of story. Wonderful storytelling!
all-complete.transcript: You repaired every kind of story. Wonderful storytelling!

fox-bridge-setup.intended: Fia Fox wants to visit her friend across the stream. The path stops at the water. What could help Fia cross?
fox-bridge-setup.transcript: Fia Fox wants to visit her friend across the stream. The path stops at the water. What could help Fia cross?

fox-bridge-success.intended: A bridge joins the path. Now Fia can visit her friend!
fox-bridge-success.transcript: A bridge joins the path. Now Fia can visit her friend!

nia-sunflower-setup.intended: Nia planted a tiny seed. She gave it water and sunshine every day. What grew next?
nia-sunflower-setup.transcript: Nia planted a tiny seed. She gave it water and sunshine every day. What grew next?

nia-sunflower-success.intended: A bright sunflower grew from Nia’s tiny seed!
nia-sunflower-success.transcript: A bright sunflower grew from Nia’s tiny seed!

leo-umbrella-setup.intended: Leo was walking home when raindrops began to fall. What could help Leo stay dry?
leo-umbrella-setup.transcript: Leo was walking home when raindrops began to fall. What could help Leo stay dry?

leo-umbrella-success.intended: Leo opened the umbrella and stayed cozy and dry!
leo-umbrella-success.transcript: Leo opened the umbrella and stayed cozy and dry!

fish-bicycle-setup.intended: Finn Fish swam around his bowl. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?
fish-bicycle-setup.transcript: Finn Fish swam around his bowl. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?

fish-bicycle-success.intended: Finn zoomed away on a tiny bicycle. What a wonderfully wild story!
fish-bicycle-success.transcript: Finn zoomed away on a tiny bicycle. What a wonderfully wild story!

dragon-trumpet-setup.intended: Dara Dragon put on pajamas and yawned. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?
dragon-trumpet-setup.transcript: Dara Dragon put on pajamas and yawned. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?

dragon-trumpet-success.intended: Dara played a trumpet while roller-skating to bed. So silly!
dragon-trumpet-success.transcript: Dara played a trumpet while roller-skating to bed. So silly!

bear-moon-soup-setup.intended: Milo Bear set the table for supper. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?
bear-moon-soup-setup.transcript: Milo Bear set the table for supper. Which wild ending makes this story giggle?

bear-moon-soup-success.intended: The moon came down for soup with Milo. A deliciously wild ending!
bear-moon-soup-success.transcript: The moon came down for soup with Milo. A deliciously wild ending!
